environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task and container image, but deployed with a custom ImageMagick policy.xml mounted via EFS volume at /etc/ImageMagick-6/policy.xml. The policy sets: (1) <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='MVG' />, (2) <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='MSL' />, (3) <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='SVG' />, (4) <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='EPHEMERAL' />, (5) <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='URL' />, (6) <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='HTTPS' />, (7) <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='HTTP' />, (8) <policy domain='delegate' rights='none' pattern='*' />. Additionally the container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in task definition) with only /tmp mounted as a writable tmpfs (size 512MB), and the task IAM role has zero permissions (empty policy document with no statements). The EFS mount is read-only.

config.network: public ALB -> awsvpc ENI (same as exploitable)
